annotations.title: Render a Reply or Workflow Diagram

description: Use for complex written procedures, exceptions and handoffs selected from long documents or authorized conversation context when source-traceable, editable workflow views help. Prefer native visualization for simple jobs it already handles; Unseen also supplies visuals when a suitable host renderer is absent or explicitly requested. No product mention or upload is required for replies. Keep disconnected workstreams separate; cross-visual stitching, whole-project memory, live dashboards and arbitrary graphs are unsupported. Pass a source-cited VisualSpec as spec for zero-credit deterministic rendering. Declare source origins (assistant/conversation/document/retrieved/tool); assistant suggestions are proposals, not document policy. Sources and arrays follow the schema; unknown fields are rejected. Bounded infographic groups are available only when the user asks for that visual organization. MCP defaults to renderFormat='mermaid'. Render that returned graph using the chatbot's own tools in the conversation; do not embed Unseen or Studio. Request 'preview' with includeSvg=true only for an explicit SVG/PNG export or fallback. A Mermaid code block alone is not a displayed diagram; disclose when host rendering is unavailable. Retain spec, sources, supporting rules and warnings; Mermaid alone is not the full evidence record. Label summaries as derived views and disclose omissions. Retain response-only artifacts; Studio and get_workflow need saved output. Relay needs_input questions with original evidence and answers before expiry. Hosted raw text/sources without spec uses generation credits and requires explicit consent; never switch modes silently.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) obtained from `auth_verify_otp` or `auth_login` if not already supplied in the HTTP `Authorization: Bearer` header.

granularity.description: Target scope level: 'overview' for a parent lifecycle summary, 'subprocess' when paired with focusSourceIds, or 'all'.

orientation.description: Desired orientation: Mermaid emits TD for portrait or LR for landscape; choose uses existing auto-orientation. The host renderer controls final geometry.

swimlane.description: Optional swimlane layout toggle (defaults to automatic swimlanes when 2+ actor groups exist)

evidenceCoverage.description: Optional document preflight coverage report from the host agent (`pagesExamined`, `totalPages`, `textExtracted`, `tablesExtracted`, `embeddedDiagramsDetected`, `omittedMedia`, `notes`). When omitted media or uninspected diagrams are reported, Unseen flags `EVIDENCE_NOT_INSPECTED`.

focusSourceIds.description: Optional subset of source IDs to focus on when compiling a specific subprocess or phase returned by detect_workflows.

hostContext.description: Optional advisory context observed by the host agent

includeExcalidraw.description: Explicitly include or omit inline Excalidraw scene JSON (defaults to true only for 'full').

includeSvg.description: Explicitly include or omit inline SVG XML (defaults to true for 'full' and 'svg', false for 'preview'/'compact'/'mermaid').

jobId.description: Exact jobId returned by needs_input. Resend the original evidence and all answers before expiresAt.

maxPreviewHeight.description: Target preview height bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 900).

maxPreviewWidth.description: Target preview width bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 1200).

priorAnswers.description: Answers to prior Unseen clarification questions when resuming a compilation

answer.description: User's answer to the clarification question

renderFormat.description: Optional output size control (MCP defaults to 'mermaid' for the host to render). Use 'preview' for a bounded inline PNG on the hosted service, with Mermaid and an owner-only SVG URL when available, or 'svg'/'mermaid' for a single format.

sources.description: Hosted AI mode when `spec` is omitted. Pass 1–60 verbatim excerpts with locators, up to 2,000 characters each. Preserve thresholds, actors, and branches. Uses the account's generation allowance or credits.

spec.description: Free deterministic mode. Pass a prepared VisualSpec v0.1 (`{schemaVersion:'0.1', kind:'flowchart', title, summary, sources, nodes, edges}`). Label outgoing decision edges. Unseen validates and renders it at zero credits without server AI.

label.description: Required on every outgoing decision branch. Preserve the stated condition.

nodes.description: At most 60 flow nodes and 60 supporting-rule nodes. Reuse stable IDs on correction.

locator.description: Attribute a selected assistant reply, user statement, or actual retrieved reference.

origin.description: Declare who supplied this excerpt. Assistant proposals are not document rules; tool receipts alone establish executed outcomes. Caller attribution is not independently verified.

text.description: Hosted AI mode when `spec` is omitted. Pass raw text if `sources` is omitted or empty. Unseen segments it and uses the account's generation allowance or credits.

userGoal.description: The overarching operational goal or process description (defaults to `spec.title` or the first line of `text`/`sources` if omitted)
